content: k8s remotecommand: Executor interface with WebSocketExecutor primary (SPDY fallback via NewFallbackExecutor); channel-multiplexed streams over one upgraded connection - channels 0=stdin 1=stdout 2=stderr 3=error 4=resize (versioned subprotocols v1..v5.channel.k8s.io, v4 adds non-zero exit code via error channel, v5 WS-native close signaling); TerminalSizeQueue.Next() feeds resize events; TTY mode merges stderr into stdout. No session persistence: shell dies when connection closes. Takeaway: versioned subprotocol negotiation + typed channels + size queue is a proven WS protocol shape for terminals.
